title: feat(record-page): a related tab's menu moves and hides it, and 「更多」 restores the default order
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-bill"} -->
_Requested by **Bill** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_016iMXWSZDzqWRWvWzdNo8wg?thread=cmsg_016iMXWSZDzqWRWvWzdNo8wg6v19uPsX6gX42G8tGcvvzb)_
Fixes #35783

repo:objectstack#5 · os-bill · session_01Utp6CbSphdunq2aJq7ktuY

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 用户看到的变化：记录页上打开某个子表页签，再点一次它就弹出「左移」「右移」「隐藏」；隐藏的子表收进「更多」，只要顺序或隐藏不是默认的，「更多」里就有「恢复默认顺序」，一点就恢复顺序并重新显示全部子表，抽屉里也一样能用。概览、附件、审批、动态这四个页签不能移动或隐藏。
- 为什么：上一次记录页改版去掉了右栏的子表卡片，读者调整子表顺序、隐藏子表的入口也随之没了；您定的是「先合并，另开卡恢复」，这次把这些操作放回到页签上。
- 如果判断错：只影响每位读者自己的页签排列，不动数据和应用配置；以前保存的顺序和隐藏照常生效，撤回这一次合并即可恢复原样。
- 需要您做的：无。

## What changes

A reader arranges the record page's related lists from their tabs again. The related cards that carried the ⠿ handle, ⌥↑ / ⌥↓ and 「隐藏」 left the page with #35763; the maintainer's decision on that removal was 「先合并，另开卡恢复」.

- **A related list's tab is its menu.** The open related tab draws a ▾ and is its own menu's trigger: click it again, or press Enter, Space or ↓ on it. The menu holds 「左移」, 「右移」 and 「隐藏」. A related tab that is not open opens on its first click or Enter, as before.
  - 「左移」 / 「右移」 move the list one place among the related lists. At either end the way out is disabled.
  - 「隐藏」 takes the list off the row into 「更多」's hidden lists and returns the page to 概览, so the face of a hidden list is not left open.
- **「更多」 restores the default.** While the order or the hidden set is not the default, 「更多」 ends with 「恢复默认顺序」 (the default order, every list shown). When nothing overflows and nothing is hidden but the order was moved, the trigger is drawn as a bare 「更多」 with that one entry. This is the reset for a drawer and an embedded pane, which have no rail.
- **Fixed tabs.** 概览, 附件, 审批 and 动态 (and an open body table) carry no menu and never move.
- **One stored arrangement.** Every edit goes through `editRelatedArrangement` in `synth/relatedArrangement.ts` (move = its `move-up` / `move-down`, hide = `hide`, reset = `restore-default-arrangement`), into the same per-reader, per-object workspace preference the cards wrote. A stored order and stored hides keep working, and the rail's 「已隐藏 N · 显示」 / 「恢复默认顺序」 foot still undoes them on a full page.
- **i18n.** Hide reuses `detail.relatedCardHide`, the reset reuses `detail.relatedRestoreDefaultOrder`, the bare trigger reuses `common.more`. No key fitted 「左移」 / 「右移」, so `detail.recordTabMoveBefore` / `detail.recordTabMoveAfter` are added in all eleven packs. They are named by position in the row, not by side: in Arabic, where the row runs right to left, "before" reads as "move right".
- **Removed.** `RelatedCardStack.tsx` and `useRelatedArrangement.ts`. Nothing else imported them once their two foot-line helpers (`RelatedDefaultChangedHint`, `RelatedFootLine`) moved into `RecordPageColumns.tsx` as module-local components, and neither is exported from the package.
- **Kept, deliberately.** `RelatedCardMenu.tsx` is not deleted: `RelatedList.tsx` still imports it (outside this card's fence). The reducer's tests (`synth/__tests__/relatedArrangement-27055.test.ts`) are untouched.
- `RecordDetailView.tsx` is not touched. The drawer goes through the same `RecordPageColumns` path with `rail={false}`, and the host already passes the stored arrangement and its setter.

Size: 21 files, +535 / −461 (996 changed lines; 435 of the deletions are the two removed files).

## Tests

<details><summary>New pins (plugin-detail, in the shared harness file RecordPageColumns.readerArrangement-35595.test.tsx, as a new top-level describe)</summary>

- 「左移」 and 「右移」 move the open list one place and write the stored order; on the last list 「右移」 is aria-disabled (CONTROL: 「左移」 is not).
- 「隐藏」 takes the open list into 「更多」's hidden lists, writes the hidden set and returns to 概览.
- 「更多」's 「恢复默认顺序」 restores the default order and shows every list, in a drawer (`rail={false}`, no foot line); CONTROL: in the default arrangement there is no 「更多」 at all.
- A row moved but with nothing hidden still offers the reset, under a bare 「更多」.
- 概览, 附件, 审批 and 动态 open no menu and carry no `aria-haspopup`; CONTROL: an open list's tab carries `aria-haspopup="menu"` and opens its menu.
- A list's tab that is not open opens on its first click and on Enter, with no menu.
</details>

<details><summary>Playwright (ui/e2e/record-tabs-rail-35595.spec.ts, new top-level describe, Chromium, zh-CN)</summary>

- 右移 then 左移 on 联系人; CONTROL, 概览 opens no menu; 右移 on 报价单, 隐藏 on 商机 (the page returns to 概览, 商机 sits under 「更多」's hidden lists); 恢复默认顺序 brings back the default order; CONTROL, no 「更多」 afterwards.
- It asserts only orders and presence: no width, no text width and no fixed-window fold, so it does not depend on CJK fonts.
</details>

- Retired: none.
- Edited: `RecordPageColumns.readerArrangement-35595.test.tsx` (header now says the move and hide came back on the tabs; its nine existing cases are unchanged), `ui/e2e/record-tabs-rail-35595.spec.ts` (header bullet and the new describe; its five cases are unchanged).
- Removed with their modules: none. `RelatedCardStack-27055.test.tsx` was already retired by #35763, and `useRelatedArrangement` had no test of its own.

## Acceptance notes

- **Release note.** #35763's pending changeset is left exactly as it is on main. Its bullet "Reader arrangement leaves with the cards" says a reader can no longer reorder or hide a related list. This PR's own changeset says plainly that reader arrangement is back and that it supersedes that bullet: 左移 / 右移 / 隐藏 are on each related tab's menu, 「恢复默认顺序」 is in 「更多」 (in the drawer and embedded pane too), and stored arrangements keep applying. The release notes read the two changesets together.
- **Design choice: the open tab is the menu trigger.** I chose this over a separate ▾ button so that the tablist holds only tabs (`aria-haspopup="menu"` on a tab is allowed) and the row's width measuring stays the same. The ▾ is measured only on the open tab, so inactive tabs keep their width and the fold is unchanged. To move a list that is not open, the reader opens it first.
- `RelatedCardMenu.tsx` stays because `RelatedList.tsx` imports it. With `RelatedCardStack` gone, nothing in production provides `RelatedCardChromeContext`, so `RelatedList`'s `cardChrome` branch (the ⠿ handle and the ⋯ 隐藏 menu) can no longer draw on a page. Only its tests provide the context. That is dead code outside this fence; not filed.
- Stale comments name `RelatedCardStack` in `RecordDetailView.tsx` (around lines 1277 and 4327), `RelatedList.tsx` (around line 1370) and `ui/packages/plugin-detail/README.md` (line 849). All are outside the fence and were not touched.
- The 48 h 「新」 badge and the `mark-seen` stamp were the cards' (`useRelatedArrangement`). They do not come back on the tabs, and a relationship new since the reader's last move is still placed by the reducer's rule 3.
- The rail's foot line (「已隐藏 N · 显示」, 「恢复默认顺序」, the changed-default hint) is kept on a full page. On a full page the reset is therefore offered twice, in the rail's foot and in 「更多」.

## Verification

Two-minute check: open a record with three or more related lists at 1280 × 800. Open the second list's tab and click it again; expect 左移 / 右移 / 隐藏. Choose 左移, and the tab moves one place left. Choose 隐藏 on another list: the page returns to 概览, and 「更多」 lists it under 已隐藏 with 恢复默认顺序 at the end. Choose 恢复默认顺序: the default order comes back with every list. Do the same in the record drawer.

Read first:
1. `ui/packages/plugin-detail/src/RecordTabRow.tsx`: the related tab wrapped as a controlled `DropdownMenu` trigger, and its `onOpenChange` / `onKeyDown`. A tab that is not open must select, not open a menu.
2. `ui/packages/plugin-detail/src/RecordPageColumns.tsx`: `arrangeTab` (hiding the open tab closes its face) and `onResetArrangement` (offered only while `resolved.rearranged`).
3. `ui/packages/plugin-detail/src/synth/recordTabRow.ts`: `alwaysInDropdown` now counts the reset entry, which makes the dropdown exist.

Gates: on head 17dd9e49a85, `dispatch-gates.mjs --commands` derived 48 families and all 48 ran locally (`--ran`: 48 derived, 48 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED). On head 95aefa18c37, which only restores #35763's changeset and rewrites this PR's own, the changeset families were run again and every one exited 0: `check-empty-changeset --base origin/main` and its `--self-test`, `check-changeset-no-major`, `check-adr-0087-registration` and its `--self-test`, `check:changeset-gate-self-tests`, `check-closing-keyword-parity` and its `--self-test`, `check:nul-bytes`. `check-platform-checklist --changed-from origin/main`: OK, 2 anchors judged, 0 lost. `overlap-check` before each push exited 0 (it shares the locale files with #35747, which merges cleanly).
